title: Clonedivers LEGO Compact Garment Registry
description: Extensible runtime garment configuration schema for clonedivers.lego-compact-leaf-writer (>= 0.1.0). Allows Wave 2 LEGO Clone kits and additional compact torso/limb/helmet garments to register alongside baked Stormtrooper tables without recompiling.

kit_pack.description: Optional identifier for the mod pack supplying these garments (e.g. 'Wave 2 LEGO Clone Kits').

garments.description: Additional compact garment unit definitions appended after the 7 baked Stormtrooper entries (max 256 total garments).

hexResourceId.description: 64-bit Stingray compact garment Unit resource hash as 16-char hexadecimal.

node.description: Destination compact garment skeleton graph node index (< node_count).

ordinal.description: 1-based RenderMeta skinned mesh ordinal within the compact garment unit.

mesh_node.description: Graph node index bound to this skinned MeshObject.

skin_mode.description: 'pinned' validates exact map/bind/counts/palette byte-for-byte; 'structural' validates live skin topology against bones/groups bounds.

bones.description: Active skin bone count for this mesh ordinal.

groups.description: Draw subgroup count for this mesh ordinal.

map.description: Skin bone-to-graph-node remap array of length 'bones'.

bind_bits.description: Exact IEEE-754 little-endian u32 words (length bones * 12) for the skin inverse-bind matrix rows.

bind.description: Alternative floating-point representation of the inverse-bind rows (length bones * 12) when bind_bits is omitted.

counts.description: Bone palette count per draw subgroup (length 'groups').

palette.description: Per-subgroup bone palette indices referencing 'map' (length 'groups', inner length counts[q]).

node_count.description: Compact graph node count for Unit+0x70 and SceneGraph.

aliases.description: Mappings from source 65-bone LEGO rig to this compact garment graph.
